controls: Per-recipient 256-bit bearer keys; only hashes in server configuration
Reject absent, expired and revoked keys before fetching GitHub
GitHub token is server-side and repository-scoped read-only
One pinned GitHub commit per response; verified manifest and SHA256 of client
No public fallback or public response caching
Issued files and local credentials excluded from Git

chromium.mode: Real Chromium synchronous cross-origin XHR with Authorization; service and private GitHub responses are fixtures

pending: Create/deploy Worker in the owner Cloudflare account
Configure GitHub read-only token and license hashes as Worker secrets
Issue owner JSON for the real Worker address and verify end-to-end
Switch repository visibility to private and verify authorized and anonymous access
limits: Authorized recipients can save the JS or forward their JSON/key
Revocation blocks future downloads but cannot recall saved copies
Previously public copies cannot be withdrawn
